decisions.rationale: The relation language now refuses every cardinality spelling the storage lowerer does not implement, so the cardinality axis is no longer a choice and leaves the derived ledger. The remaining observed relation obligations are still declaration and lowering evidence, not execution evidence, and remain explicit coverage debt until the sibling corpus supplies receipts. Join eligibility is deliberately NOT narrowed here: it is still accepted with zero consumers, is a known ADR-0041 violation left open on the record, and is owned by row lang-retire because every checked-in release entry has already serialized it.
decisions.revisitCondition: Replace this decision with execution or stable-refusal receipts from the sibling relation corpus; any change to the exact observed relation obligation set, including widening the declined cardinality axis or retiring join eligibility under lang-retire, invalidates this decision immediately.
